get.summary: List financial accounts and their SGD totals

200.description: The original account list for requests without parameters, or the reporting overview when requested.

get.description: Omit all parameters for the original account list response. Use view=overview or supply both from and to for account balances, the earliest activity dates, and full reporting totals. Balances include opening balances, all recorded transactions, outgoing and incoming cash transfers, and brokerage trade cash movements. Income, expenses, and net cashflow use the inclusive reporting period and exclude cash transfers and ETF trades. Without dates, totals use the current calendar month in Asia/Singapore.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Include account balances, earliest activity dates, net cashflow, and reporting period dates.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the reporting period, inclusive. Requires to.

schema.description: A valid Gregorian calendar date in year 0001 or later.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the reporting period, inclusive. Requires from.

schema.description: A valid Gregorian calendar date in year 0001 or later.

post.summary: Open a bank or brokerage financial account

patch.summary: Correct a financial account's name, opening date, and opening balance
patch.description: Updates the existing account in place. Opening balance corrections contribute zero to income and expenses. The opening date must be on or before the earliest recorded entry.

delete.summary: Permanently delete an unused financial account

get.summary: List an account's transactions and optionally its transfers
get.description: Filters are optional and combine. Date bounds are inclusive. Within each list, rows are sorted by date, then creation time, newest first.

parameters.name: includeTransfers
parameters.description: Set to true to include cash transfers. Transfers match the date bounds and are excluded when filtering by everyday transaction type or category.

schema.description: A valid Gregorian calendar date in year 0001 or later.
A valid Gregorian calendar date in year 0001 or later.

post.summary: Record an income or expense transaction

patch.description: Replaces the editable fields, including the destination account, while retaining the same transaction ID.

delete.description: Removes the transaction from active history and recalculates the account balance and everyday cashflow. A private audit record is retained.

post.description: Records one transfer that debits the source account and credits the destination account by the same SGD amount.

patch.description: Replaces the source account, destination account, date, and amount while retaining the same transfer ID.

delete.description: Removes the transfer from both account histories and reverses the source and destination balance effects together. Total cash and everyday cashflow are unchanged. A private audit record is retained.

post.summary: Record an SGD ETF buy or sell
post.description: Trades are ordered by date, then entry order. Same-date everyday transactions and cash transfers are included before trade funding is checked. A backdated trade is rejected if it would leave any buy unfunded or any sale short of units.

get.summary: Read an owned brokerage account's ETF holdings and trades
get.description: Trades include their signed brokerage cash movements in reverse execution order. Closed positions remain available for trade history, fees and realised profit or loss.

404.description: The brokerage account or trade is unavailable to this owner.

get.summary: Read the known SGD portfolio subtotal and valuation completeness
get.description: The known subtotal includes recorded cash. A portfolio with open holdings awaiting price has partial valuation. Unpriced holdings contribute no market value to the known subtotal.
